about: Step onto the pitch in the most authentic Rugby League experience ever!
Whether you're chasing club glory, building a custom ‘Pro Team’, or rising through the ranks with a self-made superstar, Rugby League 26 puts YOU at the heart of the action.
Career Mode – Lead your team from local battlers to league legends.
Pro Team – Assemble your dream squad and compete online or offline.
Be a Pro – Create, train, and evolve your own player across seasons.
